style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshot field, one deep matte #0C0A09 dark copy field for a benefit hero, pale #DBEAF5 infographic band on top of a matte concrete #C6C3BF work surface
style.direction: premium DIY refinish commerce, flat graphic infographic fields mixed with clean studio product photography
style.iconSystem: thin single-stroke callout lines ending in a small dot, single accent #1B75BC, no pictograms, no badges, no seals
style.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, front-left soft key with fill card, soft contact shadows only, one skimming or sweeping highlight per detail shot, single consistent colour temperature
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium DIY refinish commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a clean #FFFFFF packshot field, a pale #DBEAF5 infographic band, a matte concrete #C6C3BF work surface and one cobalt accent #1B75BC, with deep #0C0A09 reserved for a single dark benefit hero; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left soft key, fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one short headline and at most four short labels; thin single-stroke callout lines ending in a dot as the only graphic device; clean product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable upright slight 3/4 to straight-on product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no reproduced source lettering.
noDrift: no reproduced source label artwork or source lettering
style.presentationRules: product stays upright with the cap end up at a stable slight 3/4 to straight-on angle, one consistent scale anchor, the coated result is always shown on real furniture or vessel props rather than on the product body
style.surfaceSystem: matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF, pale seamless studio ground #D3D0CB, raw timber and bare sheet-metal accents as substrate tiles
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most four short labels, always generic placeholder copy, never a reproduction of source lettering
